cd /workspace/project && python3 - <<'PY'
import json
d=json.load(open('/tmp/open.json'))
print("=== fee per bounty ===")
for it in d['items']:
    fee=it.get('entryFeeUsd')
    print(f"  {it['slug']:34} fee={fee if fee is not None else 'GRATIS':>7}  pot=${it.get('potUsd')}")
PY
